issues.description: In the solution repository the Note model's creationDate field is declared as String, but the server-side NoteService sets creationDate using an Instant (Instant.now()). This type mismatch (String vs Instant) causes a compile-time error and contradicts the template and the problem statement which use an Instant for creationDate. This inconsistency will prevent the project from compiling and confuses students about the intended type for Note.creationDate.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Note.creationDate type consistent across repositories and with the problem statement. Either change the solution common model to use java.time.Instant (restore the template's type) or update NoteService to set a String (for example note.setCreationDate(Instant.now().toString())). Preferably align the common model, server service, and examples in the problem statement to use Instant to match the original template and intended design.
